title: Open edX Stack Variables
description: Variables for Open edX LMS and CMS stack deployment.

OPENEDX_VERSION.description: Open edX release or git branch (e.g., 'master', 'open-release/quince.master').

LMS_HOST.description: Public domain/host for LMS web interface.

CMS_HOST.description: Public domain/host for Studio / CMS authoring interface.

LMS_PORT.description: Internal HTTP port for LMS WSGI server.

CMS_PORT.description: Internal HTTP port for CMS WSGI server.

OPENEDX_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for Django sessions and token encryption.

OPENEDX_BACKUP_DIR.description: Directory where backup archives are generated.

OPENEDX_THEME.description: Active Comprehensive Theme name for LMS and Studio.

OPENEDX_THEME_REPO_URL.description: Git repository URL of custom Comprehensive Theme.

OPENEDX_INSTALL_DIR.description: Directory where openedx-platform is checked out and deployed.

OPENEDX_IMPORT_DEMO_COURSE.description: Whether to import the edX demo course during setup.

OPENEDX_IMPORT_DEMO_LIBRARIES.description: Whether to import demo content libraries during setup.

OPENEDX_ENABLE_WORKERS.description: Whether to enable and launch Celery background workers.

OPENEDX_ENABLE_CELERY_BEAT.description: Whether to enable Celery Beat periodic task scheduler.

OPENEDX_ENABLE_MFES.description: Whether to build and route Micro-Frontends (Learning, Authn, Account, Authoring).

OPENEDX_MFE_AUTHORING_PORT.description: HTTP port for Course Authoring Micro-Frontend.

db_strategy.description: Database provisioning strategy (e.g. relational vs nosql).

db_url.description: Full database connection string or URL.

PLATFORM_NAME.description: The public name of this Open edX instance.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Public contact email displayed across LMS.

LANGUAGE_CODE.description: Default language code for Open edX UI.

ENABLE_HTTPS.description: Whether TLS/HTTPS is terminated for public web traffic.

ENABLE_WEB_PROXY.description: Whether local reverse proxy (Caddy/Nginx) is enabled.

CADDY_HTTP_PORT.description: HTTP listening port for reverse proxy ingress.

NPM_REGISTRY.description: Custom or standard NPM registry URL.

EDX_PLATFORM_VERSION.description: Git branch, tag, or commit for edx-platform.

OPENEDX_COMMON_VERSION.description: Canonical Open edX release version identifier.

ATLAS_REPOSITORY.description: Repository for Open edX internationalization strings.

ATLAS_OPTIONS.description: Additional flags passed to the Atlas translation tool.

OPENEDX_EXTRA_PIP_REQUIREMENTS.description: Additional Python requirements installed in LMS/CMS.

JWT_COMMON_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for signing symmetric JWT tokens.

JWT_RSA_PRIVATE_KEY.description: 2048-bit RSA private key (PEM format) for asymmetric token signing.

CMS_OAUTH2_KEY_SSO.description: OAuth2 client ID for Studio SSO authentication.

CMS_OAUTH2_KEY_SSO_DEV.description: OAuth2 client ID for Studio SSO dev mode.

CMS_OAUTH2_SECRET.description: OAuth2 client secret for Studio SSO authentication.

RUN_MYSQL.description: Whether to manage and launch MySQL locally.

MYSQL_HOST.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address.

OPENEDX_MYSQL_DATABASE.description: MySQL database name for Open edX.

OPENEDX_MYSQL_USERNAME.description: MySQL username for Open edX tables.

OPENEDX_MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: MySQL password for Open edX tables.

RUN_MONGODB.description: Whether to manage and launch MongoDB locally.

MONGODB_HOST.description: MongoDB server hostname or IP address.

MONGODB_DATABASE.description: MongoDB database name for course structures.

MONGODB_AUTH_SOURCE.description: MongoDB database against which credentials are authenticated.

MONGODB_REPLICA_SET.description: MongoDB replica set name if clustering is enabled.

MONGODB_USE_SSL.description: Whether TLS/SSL is required for MongoDB connections.

RUN_REDIS.description: Whether to manage and launch Redis locally.

REDIS_HOST.description: Redis server hostname or IP address.

OPENEDX_CACHE_REDIS_DB.description: Redis database index allocated for application caching.

OPENEDX_CELERY_REDIS_DB.description: Redis database index allocated for Celery task queuing.

RUN_MEILISEARCH.description: Whether to manage and launch Meilisearch locally.

MEILISEARCH_INDEX_PREFIX.description: Prefix applied to all Meilisearch indexes.

MEILISEARCH_MASTER_KEY.description: Master authentication secret for Meilisearch daemon.

MEILISEARCH_API_KEY_UID.description: UUID identifying the default generated Meilisearch search API key.

MEILISEARCH_API_KEY.description: API key for search queries against Meilisearch.

RUN_SMTP.description: Whether to run a local SMTP mail relay (Exim/hMailServer).

SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP server hostname or IP address.

SMTP_USE_TLS.description: Whether STARTTLS is enabled for outbound email.

SMTP_USE_SSL.description: Whether implicit SSL is enabled for outbound email.

OPENEDX_LMS_UWSGI_WORKERS.description: Number of worker processes for LMS WSGI service.

OPENEDX_CMS_UWSGI_WORKERS.description: Number of worker processes for CMS WSGI service.

PLUGINS.description: Enabled Open edX and Tutor-compatible plugins.

MOUNTS.description: Local directory mounts bound to the application path.
